intro: You are at Sadberk Hanım Museum, in İstanbul province, opened in 1980: Türkiye's first private museum. It lives in two waterfront houses at Büyükdere, and each tells its own story. One is given to Anatolian archaeology, the other to Ottoman craft.
history: In 1980 Vehbi Koç opened Türkiye's first private museum to show the collection of his wife, Sadberk Koç. It fills two adjoining waterfront houses at Büyükdere: one is given to Anatolian archaeology, the other to Ottoman craft and dress. A personal collection, opened to everyone.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the Hüseyin Kocabaş collection and the archaeology wing. Then linger over the Ottoman embroidery and the İznik tiles.
facts: Did you know? The museum's opening cleared the way for private collections to go public in Türkiye, and most private museums in the country now follow the same model. Opened in 1980, it is Türkiye's first private museum. Of its two waterfront houses at Büyükdere, one is given to archaeology and the other to Ottoman craft.
outro: This brings our tour of Sadberk Hanım Museum to an end. Please leave the objects untouched and take your photographs without flash, so this collection stays safe for those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
